title: product-of-Mirror experts
hypothesis: Four logical nonlinear experts formed as pairwise products of two binary Mirror-view factor banks can preserve an aligned product-expert teacher using materially fewer actual bytes than four independent product experts.
physical_object: two shared 8x8 linear factor matrices, one per multiplicative branch
mirror_coordinate: two Givens views per factor; expert address is the product pair (role//2, role%2)
logical_multiplicity: four nonlinear experts f_a(x) elementwise-multiplied by g_b(x), with a,b in {0,1}
prior_art_delta: Unlike MA-010 sequential composition, MA-011 forms each expert as a multiplicative product of two separately addressed Mirror factor functions. It measures whether a factorized product structure preserves logical role diversity.
controls: four independent product experts, each with two full factor matrices
one hard-tied product expert reused for all roles
two shared factors plus per-role rank-2 residuals on both factors
two shared factors plus per-role scalar gates on both branches
two shared factors with binary Givens Mirror views and product-pair addressing

task.role_factorization: role r maps to factor codes a=r//2 and b=r%2

teacher_modes.aligned: two frozen base matrices; for each branch its two binary factor views are generated by input/output Givens conjugation; target is tanh(A_a x) elementwise-multiplied by tanh(B_b x)
teacher_modes.independent: each of four roles has two independently sampled full matrices; same tanh-product target

task.routing: balanced oracle hard top-1 role supplied to every method; router learning excluded
task.structure_audit: per-role MSE, all four factor-pair coverage, product-factor activation scale

development.selection_metric: mean held-out MSE across all five methods and both teacher modes

fresh.access_condition: At selected learning rate, aligned Mirror MSE <=1.25x full-independent product MSE and payload <=0.65x its payload; otherwise stop with fresh sealed.

storage.authority: actual serialized full inference payload bytes
storage.serialization: torch.save CPU state_dict plus deterministic compact JSON config

success_gate: All three fresh aligned worlds: Mirror MSE <=1.10x independent, payload <=0.65x independent, and all four roles have finite error. For Mirror-specific benefit it must beat rank-2 residual at comparable bytes or quality; otherwise report useful-sharing only.
failure_gate: Development gate misses; or at least two fresh aligned worlds miss either quality or byte gate; or a simpler control matches quality at equal/lower bytes in at least two worlds.
boundaries: aligned teacher deliberately favors Givens views
fixed-update screen is not capacity evidence
four logical products from two binary factor banks
